verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity management platform, so US equity compliance tracking is a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents only UK compliance automation: Companies House filings, EMI, CSOP, and SEIS/EIS. Nothing in the pack covers Rule 701 threshold tracking, Form 3921 generation, or 83(b) election handling. The 409A valuation service for US taxpayers is a separate, adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, US equity compliance — Rule 701 disclosure thresholds, Form 3921 filings, 83(b) elections — is tracked and generated from the cap table automatically
